<?php
$cnx=mysqli_connect("localhost","root","","belle_vision") or die("Erreur de connexion");

$id=$_POST["id"];
$np=$_POST["np"];


$req1="SELECT * from eleve where idEleve='$id' or nomprenom='$np'";
$res1=mysqli_query($cnx,$req1) or die("erreur1".mysqli_error($cnx));
if(mysqli_num_rows($res1)==0){
    die("identifiant  inexistant");
}
$req2="DELETE from eleve where idEleve='$id' or nomprenom='$np'";
$res2=mysqli_query($cnx,$req2) or die("erreur2".mysqli_error($cnx));
if(mysqli_affected_rows($cnx)!=0){
    die("eleve a ete supprimée à".date("d/m/y h:i:s"));
}
else {
    die("supression invalide");
}


mysqli_close($cnx);
?>
